edges.notes: iOS app sends snap request to Gateway
Gateway routes snap upload request to Media microservice
Media microservice uploads snap media to CloudFront
CloudFront persists media content to S3
Media microservice connects with Friend Graph service
Gateway routes messaging transaction to Messaging microservice (MCS)
MCS writes state and metadata to Snap DB
Snap DB persists structured metadata to DynamoDB
MCS retrieves recipient connection ID and server mapping from ElastiCache
MCS pushes message to recipient Android client via active persistent server connection
